title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Mechanics — 2023
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: A body of mass 5 kg moving under a constant net force changes its velocity from 2 m/s to 10 m/s in 4 s. Calculate the force acting on it.
questions.solution:
**Step 1 — Acceleration from the first equation of motion:**
$$a = \frac{v - u}{t} = \frac{10 - 2}{4} = \frac{8}{4} = 2\ \text{m/s}^2$$

**Step 2 — Newton's second law:**
$$F = ma = 5 \times 2$$

**Step 3 — Result:**
$$F = \mathbf{10\ \text{N}}$$
The force acts in the direction of motion of the body.
questions.knowledgeNote: Using Newton's second law, a constant net force on a constant mass gives constant acceleration.
